go build -n -x -trippkgpath=example.com/trip/path .
stderr '([\\/]compile).* -trippkgpath example\.com/trip/path'

go build -o withflag$GOEXE -trippkgpath=example.com/trip/path .
go version -m withflag$GOEXE
stdout '^\tbuild\t-trippkgpath=example\.com/trip/path$'

go build -o noflag$GOEXE .
go version -m noflag$GOEXE
! stdout '^\tbuild\t-trippkgpath='

module example.com/tripmod
